verdict.rationale: iTerm2's only evidenced official command-line tools are narrow shell-integration utilities. imgcat displays images inline and it2dl downloads files, but imgcat must be fetched separately from iterm2.com/utilities and placed on PATH. The broader automation surfaces, the Python API and AppleScript, are scripting building blocks rather than a CLI, and no general-purpose or agent-oriented CLI is documented. Missing for 10: a general official CLI for controlling sessions, tabs and windows from the command line; documentation of CLI use in agent or AI workflows; machine-readable output or agent-friendly docs (llms.txt returns 404).
